extraction.policy_summary: Bosch has a formal 'Equal Opportunity Policy for Persons with Disabilities' (Equal Employment Opportunities Policy for Persons with Disabilities/PWD), publicly linked, aimed at ensuring PWDs enjoy the right to equality, life with dignity and respect. Bosch Group states it is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive workplace.
extraction.accommodation_process_summary: The Equal Opportunity Policy for Persons with Disabilities provides 'necessary safeguards to the PWDs in the form of amenities & facilities at the workplace, defines roles and tasks specifically designated for PWDs, provision for assistive devices and Grievance Redressal Mechanism.'
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: FY2025-26: 2 total 'differently abled' employees (1 male/50%, 1 female/50%) out of 3,133 total employees; 15 total differently abled workers (14 male/93%, 1 female/7%), all permanent, out of the reported worker base.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Bosch states it is 'fully committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace... in complete alignment with the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016,' via 'systematic accessibility audits and a phased implementation of enhancements across our office and plant locations.' Separately for visitors, the company states 'most of our work locations are compliant with accessibility for differently abled visitors,' with a detailed accessibility audit conducted at its Adugodi location and phased implementation of the audit's recommendations underway.
extraction.training_or_sensitization_programs: Via CSR (not stated as internal staff training), Bosch's 'Economic Empowerment of People with Disabilities (PWDs) through Skill Development' program reached 350 PwDs (100% of the thematic-area beneficiaries targeted), described as part of dedicated outreach reaching PwDs, LGBTQIA+ individuals and women 'with interventions tailored to address the specific skill development barriers each group faces, including accessible training formats, sector-specific curricula, and placement linkages.'
extraction.recruitment_details: A CSR skill-development program, 'Economic Empowerment of People with Disabilities (PWDs) through Skill Development,' reached 350 PwDs with accessible training formats and 'placement linkages' (100% of the thematic beneficiary target met). This is disability-specific outreach conducted through CSR/community programming; the filing does not state whether these placements result in hires at Bosch itself, so it is not a stated internal PwD hiring target.
extraction.compliance_details: In response to the mandated RPwD Act 2016 accessibility questions, Bosch states it is 'fully committed' to alignment via systematic accessibility audits and phased implementation across office/plant locations, and separately states 'most of our work locations are compliant' with accessibility for differently abled visitors, with an audit at its Adugodi location and phased implementation of recommendations still underway (not full attainment). No WCAG conformance level or RPwD Act statutory hiring-quota attainment percentage is stated.

evidence.quote: We have formulated a policy with the objective of the "Equal Opportunity Policy for Persons with Disabilities" to ensure that the persons with disabilities enjoy the right to equality, life with dignity and respect equally with others.
